gbm_population_evidence.quote: Advanced Solid Tumor; Metastatic Solid Tumor; GBM
ECOG performance status 0-1 or Karnofsky performance scale \>60 for GBM patients.

candidate_evidence.quote: LP-184 is a small molecule alkylating agent causing tumor cell death through DNA damage.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: in patients with advanced solid tumors who have relapsed from or are refractory to standard therapy or for whom no standard therapy is available.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: To characterize the PK of LP-184 and its metabolites in plasma by assessing the peak plasma concentration (Cmax)

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To determine the RP2D of LP-184 based on all available safety (graded by CTCAE v5.0), PK, PD and efficacy data

role_evidence.quote: Patients will receive LP-184 infusion during Day 1 and Day 8 of each 21-day cycle, for a minimum of two cycles.
to evaluate the safety, tolerability and clinical activity of LP-184 in combination with olaparib

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: small molecule alkylating agent causing tumor cell death through DNA damage

role_evidence.quote: to evaluate the safety, tolerability and clinical activity of LP-184 in combination with olaparib

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: PARP inhibitor that impairs homologous recombination dependent DNA damage repair by trapping PARP1/2 on DNA, leading to synthetic lethality in BRCA1/2-deficient cells

role_evidence.quote: Nivolumab is monoclonal antibody and classified as an immune checkpoint inhibitor.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: By blocking the PD-1 receptor on the surface of T cells, Nivolumab restores immune cells' ability to recognize and attack cancer cells.

role_evidence.quote: Ipilimumab is monoclonal antibody and classified as an immune checkpoint inhibitor.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: By blocking the CTLA4 protein on the surface of T cells, Ipilimumab activates T-cells and allows T-cells to attack cancer cells.

source_quote.quote: Supplement A: Phase 1b/2 Expansion cohort of participants with triple negative breast cancer (TNBC), non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PDAC) or other solid tumours with known DDR genomic alterations

flag.reason: DDR alteration is linked to the DNA-damaging alkylator LP-184 by implication (keywords: DNA damage repair), but the record does not state the link explicitly.

source_quote.quote: Supplement D: Phase 1b/2 Expansion cohort of participants with KEAP1 and/or STK11-mutated and programmed cell death ligand-1 (PD-L1)-low NSCLC

flag.reason: Cohort selection marker for the nivolumab+ipilimumab cohort; no stated mechanistic link to a candidate in the record.

source_quote.quote: Supplement D: Phase 1b/2 Expansion cohort of participants with KEAP1 and/or STK11-mutated and programmed cell death ligand-1 (PD-L1)-low NSCLC

flag.reason: PD-L1-low selection for a PD-1/CTLA-4 checkpoint combination; PD-1 pathway link is mechanistic but low expression is not a predictive-positive selection.

source_quote.quote: Supplement C: Phase 1b/2 Expansion cohort of participants with Hormone Receptor (HR)-Negative and HER2-Negative Breast Cancer (TNBC)
Is willing to provide archived samples (blocks and/or slides) for comprehensive DDR genomic analyses and/or PTGR1 expression profiling and/or other genomic alterations if the patient has a PR/CR.

coder_notes: Basket phase 1/2 master protocol with GBM named in conditions. Arms: Master Protocol and Supplement A = LP-184 alone; Supplement C = LP-184 + olaparib (TNBC); Supplement D = LP-184 + nivolumab + ipilimumab (NSCLC). LP-184 coded experimental_monotherapy (master arm); in Supplements C/D it is one of several non-backbone agents (would be experimental_combination); partners coded experimental_combination. Trial regimen coded combination because some experimental arms combine agents, but the GBM-relevant Master Protocol arm is monotherapy. PTGR1 appears only as preferential-enrolment note and archival profiling, not an entry requirement. PK is plasma only.
